page.layout: One printed page. Top: dedication title block, centred (headings and lines). Below: running text in one column with a woodcut initial. Show-through text from the reverse page is faint in the background and is not transcribed. No margin notes.

main_text.head: Inlustr. Potentissimisque Dominis, OPTIMIS MAXIMISQVE FOEDERATARVM PROVINCIARVM BELGICÆ ORDINIBVS Simulque Nobilissimis, Amplissimis, Doctissimis Viris, EORVMDEM CONSILIARIIS FIDELISSIMIS Dominis summa mihi observantia colendis, PAVLLVS G.F.P.N. MERVLA D. D.
main_text.p: A quo tempore Studijs, quæ momenti majoris seriaque, tractandis animum adplicare coepi, VIRI MAGNI, præter Iurisprudentiam, quæ præcipue in oculis & mente semper fuit, incredibile, quantum mihi, liberum & effrenem amanti cursum, placuerit Πολυμάθεια quædam, & varia Rerum Divinarum Humanarumque, si non plena solidaque, certe aliqua, quæque Instituto primario juvando atque exornando satis

page.notes: The woodcut initial is an "A" with foliate ornament. The Greek word "Πολυμάθεια" is printed in Greek letters. The asterisk mark after "exornando" is a catchword-area ornament; the word "satis" at the foot is treated as the catchword. Faint show-through of the reverse page is present throughout and was omitted.
